title: Super Hopper
summary: Run, jump and stomp through a big level. Grab coins, jump the pits, and reach the flag!
learn: make a hero fall, run, and jump only from the ground
explore a level five screens wide
collect coins and stomp on beetles
choose what happens with if and else

chapters.title: Run
chapters.idea: Gravity pulls down. The ground holds you up.

chapters.title: Jump
chapters.idea: You can only jump from the ground.

chapters.title: Coins
chapters.idea: One set of blocks works for every coin.

chapters.title: Pits
chapters.idea: Keep checking where the hero is.

chapters.title: Beetles
chapters.idea: If this, do that. Else, do the other thing.

steps.title: Make the hero fall
steps.text: This level is five screens wide! First, give the Hero <<gravity|ay>>.
steps.why: <<ay>> is gravity: it pulls down. The grass is <<solid>>, like a floor.

checklist.text: Snap ((Physics#scene_motion_set|set sprite Hero ay to −1200)) under ((Events#hat:start|when game starts))
Make your guess
Press [[Run code]] to see

hints: In {{Physics}}, use ((Physics#scene_motion_set|set sprite … vx to …)) and pick ay in its menu. Snap it under ((Events#hat:start|when game starts)).

predict.question: What will the Hero do?
choices: Fall and land on the grass
Fall through the grass and off the screen
predict.explain: Gravity pulls the Hero down. The grass is solid, so the Hero lands on it.

steps.coach: Gravity is in Physics. Tap it!

steps.title: Run!
steps.text: Walk the Hero with [←] and [→]. The <<camera>> follows!
steps.why: Vertical speed 0 leaves up and down to gravity. The camera follows the Hero, so the level slides along as you walk.

checklist.text: Snap ((Motion#scene_control|control sprite Hero with arrow keys)) under ((Events#hat:start|when game starts))
Make the vertical speed 0
Run it, tap the game, and hold [→]

hints: In {{Motion}}, find ((Motion#scene_control|control sprite … with arrow keys …)). Snap it under ((Events#hat:start|when game starts)).
Pick Hero. Horizontal speed 180, vertical speed 0. Tap the game before you press keys.
steps.coach: The walking block is in Motion.

steps.title: Face the way you walk
steps.text: The Hero always looks right. Make it turn around when you press [←].
steps.why: Direction 180 means facing left. The Hero flips like a mirror. It doesn’t turn upside down.

checklist.text: When [←] is pressed, ((Motion#scene_set|set sprite Hero direction to 180))
When [→] is pressed, set it back to 0

hints: From {{Events}}, drag ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)) and change space to left arrow. In {{Motion}}, ((Motion#scene_set|set sprite … x to …)) has a menu: pick direction.
Make two of them: [←] sets direction to 180, and [→] sets it to 0.

steps.title: Jump!
steps.text: Press [space] to jump. But only from the ground!
steps.why: A jump is a quick push up, and gravity brings the Hero back down. “If <<grounded>>” means: only when standing on something.

checklist.text: Under ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)), add ((Physics#scene_jump|sprite Hero jump if grounded at speed 520))
Make your guess
Press [[Run code]] to see

hints: In {{Physics}}, find ((Physics#scene_jump|sprite … jump if grounded at speed …)).
Snap it under ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)). Pick Hero and type 520.

predict.question: What happens if you press space while the Hero is in the air?
choices: Nothing: it jumps only from the ground
It jumps again, higher and higher
predict.explain: “Jump if grounded” only works on the ground. So no flying up to the flag!

steps.title: Grab the coins
steps.text: We put 12 coins in the level, but the Hero walks right through them! Make each coin give a point and disappear.
steps.why: The coins are <<clones|clone>> of one hidden Coin. Blocks on Coin work for every coin. <<this sprite>> means the coin you touched.

checklist.text: Pick Coin and drag ((Events#hat:overlap|when Coin overlaps Hero))
Add ((Game#game_change|change score by 1))
Last of all: ((Game#scene_destroy|destroy sprite this sprite))

hints: Pick Coin. From {{Events}}, drag ((Events#hat:overlap|when Coin overlaps …)) and choose Hero.
Inside: ((Game#game_change|change score by 1)), then ((Game#scene_destroy|destroy sprite this sprite)). <<Destroy|destroy>> goes last.

steps.title: Play it: 5 coins
steps.why: The first coins are right in front of you. Tap the game, then hold [→].

steps.title: Watch out for pits
steps.text: Falling into a pit should cost a life. Start with 3 lives.
steps.why: Pits have no ground, so the Hero keeps falling. ((Events#hat:update|when Hero updates)) runs about 30 times a second (<<see why|updates>>), so it notices right away. At 0 lives, the game ends.

checklist.text: When the game starts, ((Game#game_set:FIELD=lives|set lives to 3))
In ((Events#hat:update|when Hero updates)), check if the Hero’s <<y>> is below −200
If it is: ((Game#game_change|change lives by −1)) and ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Hero to x −128 y 40))

hints: From {{Game}}, set lives to 3 when the game starts. Then pick Hero and drag ((Events#hat:update|when Hero updates)) from {{Events}}.
Inside: if Hero’s y < −200, then ((Game#game_change|change lives by −1)) and ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite Hero to x −128 y 40)).

steps.title: Beetles!
steps.text: Make the Beetle walk, and send a second beetle further on. What will a beetle do at a grey block?
steps.why: Grey blocks are <<solid>>. A <<clone>> copies its sprite’s speed, so the second beetle walks too.

checklist.text: Under ((Events#hat:start|when game starts)): ((Physics#scene_motion_set|set sprite Beetle vx to −60)) and ((Physics#scene_motion_response|sprite Beetle on wall collision bounce))
Send a copy further on: ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite clone sprite Beetle to x 1600 y −80))
Make your guess
Press [[Run code]] to see

hints: In {{Physics}}: ((Physics#scene_motion_set|set sprite Beetle vx to −60)) and ((Physics#scene_motion_response|sprite Beetle on wall collision bounce)), under ((Events#hat:start|when game starts)).
Then add ((Motion#scene_go|move sprite … to x … y …)) and put ((Game#scene_clone|clone sprite Beetle)) in its sprite hole. Use x 1600 and y −80.

predict.question: What will a beetle do at a grey block?
predict.explain: <<Bounce|bounce>> flips its speed: −60 becomes 60. So the beetle walks back and forth.

steps.title: Stomp or ouch
steps.text: When a beetle touches the Hero: landing on top is a stomp! Walking into it is an ouch.
steps.why: vy below 0 means falling down, so the Hero is landing on top: stomp! Walking in has vy 0: ouch! (<<What is if … else?|if>>)

checklist.text: Pick Beetle and drag ((Events#hat:overlap|when Beetle overlaps Hero))
Use ((Control#controls_if:else|if … else)) to check the Hero’s <<vy>>
If the Hero is falling: bounce it up, add 5 points, and destroy the beetle
Else: lose a life and go back to the start

hints: Pick Beetle and drag ((Events#hat:overlap|when Beetle overlaps …)), choosing Hero. Inside, use ((Control#controls_if:else|if … else)) from {{Control}}.
Check ((Physics#scene_motion_get|sprite Hero motion vy)) < 0. If: set Hero vy to 380, change score by 5, destroy this sprite. Else: change lives by −1 and move Hero to x −128 y 40.

steps.title: Reach the flag
steps.why: The flag is at the end of screen five, up the grey stairs. Reaching it is the goal of the whole level.

checklist.text: Pick Hero and drag ((Events#hat:overlap|when Hero overlaps Flag))
Inside, ((Game#game_finish|finish game win))

hints: Pick Hero. From {{Events}}, drag ((Events#hat:overlap|when Hero overlaps …)) and choose Flag.
Inside, put ((Game#game_finish|finish game win)) with your own message.

steps.title: Play to the end
steps.text: Reach the flag, or lose all three lives.
steps.why: Tap the game. [←] [→] walk and [space] jumps. Land on beetles from above!

finish.text: Your hero runs, jumps and stomps through a big level, with coins, pits, beetles and a flag. Amazing!
remix: Checkpoint: after the first beetle, make the Hero start again from there.
Bigger level: in [[Stage view]], press [[Add screen]] and paint more ledges and pits.
Bounce pad: paint a new tile, and make the Hero jump extra high on it.
